BiblicalUsage: The pygarg, a clean animal, a kind of antelope or mountain goat, listed among the beasts Israel was allowed to eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the clean and unclean lists taught Israel that God cares about the details of daily life, even what is on the table.
